name: @storyengine/shared
description: Portable types and schemas, plus the validator that reads them.
dependencyNote: TypeBox and Ajv travel with the schemas because schemas are runtime values: the authoring library (07 §4) and the validator over PORTABLE_SCHEMAS — the in-memory TypeBox objects, not the emitted JSON files, which nothing loads — are both needed at runtime. The 'no runtime dependencies' line this note used to except itself from was wrong as built and is corrected in the plan of record (workplan/04-p2-implementation.md §1.4), not here. Both are dependency-free themselves. ajv-formats was considered and dropped — date-time is the only format any portable schema uses, and a regex is cheaper than a dependency. Nothing else belongs here.
